company.name: Wild Papagayo
company.description: A private tour and transportation company operating in Guanacaste and Arenal, Costa Rica. Offers private day tours, airport transfers and private drivers -- not group bus tours.
company.service_area: Guanacaste (Papagayo, Playa Coco, Playa Hermosa, Tamarindo, Flamingo, Rincon de la Vieja) and Arenal/La Fortuna

booking_policy.final_balance: The remaining 75% is due no later than 72 hours before the service begins.
booking_policy.bookings_within_72_hours: Bookings made within 72 hours of the service require full payment at the time of booking.
booking_policy.cancellation_more_than_72_hours: Guest-requested cancellations made more than 72 hours before the service receive a refund of the refundable amount paid, less any applicable non-recoverable payment-processing costs when legally permitted.
booking_policy.cancellation_within_72_hours: Cancellations made within 72 hours of the service are non-refundable, subject to any mandatory consumer rights under Costa Rican law.
booking_policy.no_show: No-shows are 100% non-refundable, subject to any mandatory consumer rights.
booking_policy.date_changes: Date changes can be requested more than 72 hours before the service, subject to availability. Within 72 hours there is no automatic right to reschedule; any exceptional change is at Wild Papagayo's discretion.
booking_policy.wild_papagayo_cancels: If Wild Papagayo cancels and cannot offer an alternative or new date the guest accepts, the guest receives a 100% refund and Wild Papagayo covers the processing fee and refund cost.
booking_policy.weather: Normal rain does not automatically qualify for a refund. If an activity cannot operate safely, Wild Papagayo first tries to reschedule, adjust the itinerary or offer a suitable alternative.
booking_policy.payment_method: The standard electronic payment method is Compra Click (BAC). No card surcharge is added to the published price.
booking_policy.refund_costs: For international card payments via Compra Click (BAC), the non-recoverable costs are currently the original 2.50% processing fee and a US$8 bank fee per refund. No other fee is deducted.
booking_policy.refund_timing: Once an approved card refund is submitted, BAC processing currently takes approximately four days; the time for the credit to appear depends on the card issuer.
booking_policy.special_services: Multi-day journeys, lodging packages and some supplier-operated services may have different written conditions, disclosed before payment.
booking_policy.consumer_rights: Nothing in this policy limits any mandatory consumer rights under applicable Costa Rican law.

hotels.name: Andaz Peninsula Papagayo Resort, Costa Rica
hotels.description: Andaz Peninsula Papagayo Resort is a design-forward luxury property set within the private Peninsula Papagayo. Its beaches, golf access, dining and activity program make it a good match for travelers who want an upscale resort experience with a relaxed Costa Rican identity and convenient access to private day tours.

hotels.name: Borinquen Thermal Resort
hotels.description: Set in the natural beauty of the Rincón de la Vieja countryside in Guanacaste, Borinquen Thermal Resort combines hot springs, a thermal spa, and villas and bungalows surrounded by nature. Established in 1999, it offers wellness, adventure, and multiple dining venues in a secluded North Pacific setting.

hotels.name: el Mangroove Hotel
hotels.description: El Mangroove is a contemporary luxury beachfront resort on the Gulf of Papagayo, blending modern design with tropical nature. With a tranquil pool, two ocean-view restaurants, and a nature-set spa, it delivers a refined yet relaxed Pacific coast escape.

hotels.name: Four Seasons Peninsula Papagayo
hotels.description: Four Seasons Resort Costa Rica at Peninsula Papagayo is an ultra-luxury coastal retreat combining beaches, wellness, dining, golf and access to private Guanacaste adventures. It is a strong base for travelers who want polished resort service while still exploring volcanoes, wildlife and rainforest landscapes beyond the peninsula.

hotels.name: Hotel Belmar
hotels.description: A family-owned boutique hotel and 40-year flagship of the Monteverde region, Hotel Belmar blends alpine architecture with Costa Rican flair overlooking the cloud forest. A member of Design Hotels, it emphasizes regenerative sustainability, immersive nature experiences, and elevated farm-to-table cuisine.

hotels.name: Hotel Bosque del Mar
hotels.description: Hotel Bosque del Mar is a boutique beachfront hotel directly on Playa Hermosa, one of Guanacaste's most walkable beach towns. Its Niromi Restaurant and Nya Bar overlook the water, and rooms range from garden-view suites to Ocean Front Suites just steps from the sand. Staying in Playa Hermosa also gives travelers quick access to nearby beaches, restaurants and private excursions throughout northern Guanacaste.

hotels.name: Hotel Hacienda Guachipelín
hotels.description: A family-friendly ranch hotel set in the dry tropical forest beside Rincón de la Vieja National Park, offering comfortable rooms and a huge lineup of on-site adventure tours. Guests enjoy complimentary access to waterfalls and the Río Negro hot springs.

hotels.name: Occidental Papagayo
hotels.description: Occidental Papagayo is an adults-only, all-inclusive resort set on the Gulf of Papagayo in Costa Rica's Guanacaste province. Geared to couples and grown-up getaways, it pairs a beachfront Pacific setting with full all-inclusive dining and resort amenities.

hotels.name: Hotel Riu Guanacaste
hotels.description: Hotel Riu Guanacaste is a large all-inclusive resort on Playa Matapalo, built around the Splash Water World water park, three outdoor pools and seven bars. It's part of the RIU chain, known for high-energy, all-inclusive stays rather than boutique intimacy.

hotels.name: Hotel Riu Palace Costa Rica
hotels.description: A large beachfront all-inclusive resort on Playa Matapalo, framed by green mountains and the Pacific. With 24-hour all-inclusive service, six pools, a water park, spa, and lively entertainment, it's built for carefree family beach holidays.

hotels.name: Nekajui, A Ritz-Carlton Reserve
hotels.description: Nekajui Peninsula Papagayo is a five-star Ritz-Carlton Reserve set within a 567-hectare private peninsula on Costa Rica's Pacific coast. Surrounded by protected forest and turquoise waters above Playa Pochote, it blends refined dining, a Nicoyan-inspired spa, and treetop luxury accommodations.

hotels.name: Planet Hollywood Costa Rica
hotels.description: Planet Hollywood Costa Rica is an all-inclusive resort on Bahía Culebra with Hollywood-movie theming throughout, seven on-site restaurants, a kids splash pad and the PH Spa. It's built for families and groups who want entertainment on property.

hotels.name: Buena Vista del Rincón
hotels.description: Buena Vista del Rincón is an eco adventure park, hotel and spa nestled in the rainforest foothills of the Rincón de la Vieja volcano in Guanacaste. With 76 rooms, natural volcanic hot springs, and an on-site adventure park, it blends thrill and relaxation in a lush mountain setting.

hotels.name: Secrets Papagayo Costa Rica
hotels.description: Secrets Papagayo Costa Rica is a Preferred Club all-inclusive resort on the Golfo de Papagayo, part of AMResorts' adults-oriented Secrets brand. Its Unlimited-Luxury program includes seven dining options and a full-service spa.

hotels.name: Suitree Experience Hotel
hotels.description: Suitree is an architectural treehouse retreat set 9 meters above the forest floor in Guanacaste, where light, elevated suites blend into the jungle canopy. Guests enjoy panoramic mountain views, deep nature immersion, and a refined slow-food dining experience in total seclusion.

hotels.name: Waldorf Astoria Costa Rica Punta Cacique
hotels.description: Waldorf Astoria Costa Rica Punta Cacique is a secluded luxury resort overlooking Playa Penca on Guanacaste's Pacific coast. Its short airport transfer, oceanfront setting, spa and refined resort experience make it especially appealing to couples, families and travelers seeking privacy with convenient access to nearby beach towns and private excursions.

tours.name: Arenal Hanging Bridges Mistico
tours.description: Private full-day Arenal Hanging Bridges experience at Mistico Park, canopy-level suspension bridges from 5 to 100 metres, La Fortuna Waterfall and optional hot springs. Breakfast and lunch included. Bilingual guide.

tours.name: Rainforest & Hot Springs Arenal
tours.description: Private full-day Arenal experience, Bogarin Trail wildlife hike, La Fortuna Waterfall or Arenal National Park, thermal hot springs, breakfast and lunch included. Arenal Volcano and Central America's largest man-made lake.

tours.name: 2-Hour ATV Mountain Ride
tours.description: Two hours of private ATV adventure through unpaved mountain roads and dry forest terrain in Guanacaste. Off-the-beaten-track riding with a certified bilingual guide, exclusively for your group.

tours.name: Borinque 4 Senses Tour — Horseback, Zip Line, Waterfall & Hot Springs
tours.description: Private Borinque 4 Senses Tour, horseback riding with Pacific coast panoramas, forest hike to Misterio Waterfall, adrenaline zip line and volcanic hot springs with mud and sauna. Lunch included.

tours.name: Buena Vista Mega Combo
tours.description: Private full-day adventure at Buena Vista, Guanacaste, zip line, waterslide, hot springs and more. Certified bilingual guide. Book via WhatsApp with Wild Papagayo.

tours.name: Canyon Adventure Park — Zip, Rappel, Climb & Raft
tours.description: Private half-day at Canyon Adventure Park, zip line 7 cables with bird's-eye canopy views, rappel, rock climbing and 2-mile Class II-III rafting. Lunch included. Minimum age 6.

tours.name: Waterfall Canyoning & Tubing
tours.description: Private waterfall canyoning and river tubing, rappel into majestic falls, rock climb, Tarzan pendulum, then tube 5km of crystal-clear Class 2–3 rapids. Lunch included. Certified bilingual guide.

tours.name: Celeste River Hike & Tenorio National Park
tours.description: Private full-day hike to Río Celeste, the nearly opaque aquamarine blue river at Tenorio Volcano National Park. Lunch and national park fee included. Visitor identification details are required for national park registration and will be requested securely after booking confirmation.

tours.name: Colorado River Rafting Class II–III
tours.description: Private Class II–III white water rafting on the Colorado River, natural canyon, swimming holes and lunch included. No experience necessary. Certified bilingual guide exclusively for your group.

tours.name: Congo Trail Half-Day Adventure
tours.description: Six zip lines, hanging bridges, 45 minutes on ATV and horseback riding through Guanacaste dry forest. Half-day private adventure at Congo Trail with certified bilingual guide.

tours.name: Congo Trail Canopy & Extreme Zip Line
tours.description: Private Congo Trail experience, 11-station zip line through tropical forest with 3 hanging bridges, plus extreme cables including Superman and Tarzan Swing. The Plus option adds 2 hours ATV.

tours.name: Costa Rica Highlights Tour — Sloths, Waterfall, Coffee, Hot Springs & Hanging Bridges
tours.description: The ultimate one-day Costa Rica experience, sloth observation, waterfall, hands-on coffee and cacao workshop, natural mineral hot springs and two hanging bridges. Everything that makes Costa Rica extraordinary, in one private day.

tours.name: Floating at Tenorio River Safari Float
tours.description: Private Class 1-2 safari float down the Tenorio River, giant kapok trees, wildlife, Llanos de Cortez Waterfall. Option to add Las Pumas Rescue Center. Lunch and fruit break included.

tours.name: Hacienda Aromal Full Day
tours.description: A full day at an authentic Guanacaste hacienda, zip lines, horseback riding through the estate, ATV adventure and a traditional Sabanero lunch. Private experience with certified bilingual guide.

tours.name: Hacienda Guachipelín Extreme
tours.description: Private full-day extreme adventure at Hacienda Guachipelín, zipline, rappel, rock climbing, river tubing and hot springs in Guanacaste. Certified bilingual guide. Book with Wild Papagayo.

tours.name: Hanging Bridges & Sloths Experience
tours.description: Private hanging bridges and sloth encounter, 3 suspension bridges through tropical forest, Llanos de Cortez Waterfall and an intimate sloth experience that inspires wonder in every age. Lunch included.

tours.name: Rincon de la Vieja Hiking Tour
tours.description: Private full-day hiking in Rincon de la Vieja National Park, Guanacaste. Volcanoes, hot springs and wildlife with a certified bilingual guide. Book via WhatsApp.

tours.name: Horseback Riding at Hacienda Aromal
tours.description: Private horseback riding through Hacienda Aromal's natural trails, deer, armadillos, anteaters and tropical birds in the heart of Guanacaste. Authentic Sabanero experience with certified bilingual guide.

tours.name: La Leona Waterfall — Zip Line & Tubing
tours.description: Private La Leona Waterfall experience, a 3-hour hike through 5 river pools in a stone canyon. The Classic option adds zip line, The Plus option adds tubing. Available November to April only.

tours.name: Miravalles Volcano Waterfalls & Natural Spa
tours.description: Private full-day at Miravalles Volcano, 3 cascading waterfalls, geothermal hot springs and volcanic mud treatments in a live crater. Lunch and all entrance fees included.

tours.name: Monteverde Hanging Bridges & Coffee Tour
tours.description: Private full-day Monteverde Cloud Forest experience, 8 Selvatura suspension bridges, butterfly garden, interactive coffee plantation tour from seed to cup, sugar cane and chocolate. Breakfast and lunch included.

tours.name: Monteverde Treetop Walk
tours.description: Private full-day Monteverde Cloud Forest treetop walk, suspension bridges at canopy level with zip line (Classic option) or reptiles exhibition, butterfly garden and sloth sanctuary (Plus option). Breakfast and lunch included.

tours.name: Oropendola Waterfall & Rio Negro Hot Springs Tour
tours.description: Private tour to Oropendola Waterfall's crystal-clear swimming pool and the natural Rio Negro hot springs at the base of Rincon de la Vieja Volcano. Certified bilingual guide. Book via WhatsApp with Wild Papagayo.

tours.name: Ostional Turtle Watching Tour Costa Rica
tours.duration: Full Day into Night (approx. 10-11 hours round trip)
tours.description: Private nighttime tour to Ostional National Wildlife Refuge to witness olive ridley sea turtles nesting on the beach. Certified local community guide and responsible nighttime viewing under refuge lighting rules. Book via WhatsApp with Wild Papagayo.

tours.name: Palo Verde & Cultural Experience El Viejo
tours.description: Covered boat ride down the Tempisque River through Palo Verde National Park, then a private visit to Hacienda El Viejo, tortilla making, the ox-powered trapiche sugar mill, and traditional Guanacaste cuisine. Lunch and National Park fee included.

tours.name: Palo Verde River Boat Tour
tours.description: Private half-day riverboat excursion through Palo Verde National Park, crocodiles, monkeys, tropical birds and the Tempisque River. Certified bilingual guide. Book with Wild Papagayo.

tours.name: Sensoria Land of Senses & Magical Rainforest
tours.description: Private full-day Sensoria nature reserve, 7km rainforest trail with multiple waterfalls, thermal pools, howler monkeys and incredible biodiversity where Guanacaste transforms into lush rainforest. Walking sticks and lunch included.

tours.name: Sloth Adventure Tour Costa Rica
tours.description: Private sloth wildlife encounter in the Costa Rica rainforest. Full-day private tour with certified bilingual guide. Book via WhatsApp with Wild Papagayo.

tours.name: Sloth Adventure & Chocolate Tour
tours.description: Private chocolate tour from cacao tree to handmade bar, then a short hike in Bijagua to observe wild sloths, butterflies and toucans in their natural habitat. Lunch included. Easy, all ages.

tours.name: Tenorio River White Water Rafting Class III–IV
tours.description: Private Class III–IV white water rafting on the Tenorio River, racing rapids, plunging over falls and lush tropical wildlife. Snacks and lunch included. Certified bilingual guide exclusively for your group.

tours.name: Tubing at Río Celeste — Blue River Tubing
tours.description: Private tubing experience on Río Celeste, float through the striking aquamarine blue river in lush rainforest, navigating small rapids with birds, monkeys and rich biodiversity. Minimum age 4. Lunch included.

tours.name: Waterfall Lovers Tour Costa Rica
tours.description: Private Costa Rica waterfall and jungle tour. Discover hidden waterfalls with a certified local guide, exclusively for your group. Book via WhatsApp with Wild Papagayo.

tours.name: Waterfall & Las Pumas Wildlife Rescue Center
tours.description: Private half-day at Llanos del Cortes waterfall and Las Pumas Wildlife Rescue Center, swim under the falls, then meet pumas, jaguars, ocelots, monkeys and macaws. Lunch included. Certified bilingual guide.

destinations.name: Bijagua
destinations.description: Bijagua is a small highland village located at the base of Tenorio Volcano in Alajuela province. It serves as the primary gateway to Río Celeste and Tenorio National Park, offering one of Costa Rica's most genuine off-the-beaten-path experiences.

destinations.name: Guanacaste
destinations.description: Guanacaste is Costa Rica's northwestern Pacific province, home to some of the country's most celebrated beaches, national parks and adventure destinations. From the resort peninsula of Papagayo to the volcanic trails of Rincón de la Vieja, the region offers a diverse range of experiences for every type of traveler.

destinations.name: La Fortuna & Arenal
destinations.description: La Fortuna offers one of Costa Rica’s most complete nature experiences. Travelers can combine rainforest walks, hanging bridges, wildlife observation, waterfalls and volcanic hot springs.

destinations.name: Monteverde
destinations.description: Monteverde is one of Costa Rica's premier ecotourism destinations, home to the famed Monteverde Cloud Forest Reserve and a rich community founded by American Quakers in the 1950s. Perched high in the Cordillera de Tilarán, it offers cool climates and abundant natural beauty.

destinations.name: Papagayo
destinations.description: Papagayo combines exclusive resorts, calm Pacific beaches and convenient access to Liberia International Airport. It is an excellent base for travelers who want private service, relaxation and memorable day trips.

destinations.name: Playas del Coco
destinations.description: Playas del Coco is one of Guanacaste’s most convenient coastal bases. Visitors enjoy supermarkets, restaurants, nightlife, marina access and short transfers from Liberia Airport.

destinations.name: Playa Hermosa
destinations.description: Playa Hermosa is ideal for travelers seeking a quieter coastal stay without giving up convenient access to restaurants, private transportation and Guanacaste’s main attractions.

destinations.name: Rincón de la Vieja
destinations.description: Rincón de la Vieja is a top choice for hiking and adventure. Its volcanic terrain, forests and nearby haciendas make it possible to combine nature, hot springs, tubing, ziplining and waterfalls.

destinations.name: Río Celeste
destinations.description: Río Celeste is one of Costa Rica's most photographed natural attractions. The river's striking turquoise color is created by a natural chemical reaction where two volcanic streams converge inside Tenorio Volcano National Park.

destinations.name: Sámara
destinations.description: Sámara is a laid-back beach town and district in the Nicoya canton of Costa Rica's Guanacaste province. Sitting at sea level roughly 35 km from Nicoya, it's a relaxed corner of the Nicoya Peninsula served by a small nearby airport.

destinations.name: Tamarindo
destinations.description: Tamarindo is Guanacaste's largest developed beach town, transformed from a small fishing village into a lively surf and eco-tourism hub. Popular with surfers, digital nomads, and expats, it blends renowned surf breaks with a vibrant arts and nightlife scene.
